mentions.name: OC Renegades
mentions.description: An apparel brand selling graphic tees, hoodies, and other clothing with designs ranging from dry humor and self-deprecation to nonconformity and optimism, with custom code that integrates internal databases with Shopify and Printful's APIs.
mentions.source_excerpt: Created OC Renegades (https://ocrenegades.com), including creating the designs and writing the code to integrate internal databases with Shopify and Printufl's APIs.  We make graphic tees, hoodies, and other apparel for with designs that range from dry humor and self-deprecation to unapologetic nonconformity and the occasional dose of optimism.
